race.comment: SUPER SAM (6) made light work of the tricky draw with a quick early sectional last time clocking 22.39 in a 5 length win at this track over 390m. Won at his only start from this draw. Hard to fault his recent form and can win again. ASTOR ONES (4) has a terrific record this trip with two wins and two placings from four starts. In the money last time at this track (22.28) in a Mix 6/7 H, finishing a 0.8 lengths second. Looks suited here and can measure up. SHOOTERS PROJECT (2) is progressing well and looks close to another win after hitting the frame from Box 2 last run (22.47) at this track. Leading player again. ONE SUGAR (1) is last start winner who looks one of the chances.
